description: Defines a static class 'GrainLifecycleStage' that contains constants representing different stages of a grain's lifecycle in the Orleans framework. Includes stage identifiers like 'First', 'SetupState', 'Activate', and 'Last'.

classes.name: GrainLifecycleStage
classes.description: A static class that provides constants for various stages in the lifecycle of a grain.

methods.name: First
methods.description: Constant representing the first valid stage in a grain's lifecycle.

methods.name: SetupState
methods.description: Constant representing the stage of setting up grain state prior to activation.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Constant indicating the activation of a grain.

methods.name: Last
methods.description: Constant representing the last valid stage in a grain's lifecycle.
